reponse: Yes, a new test is needed. Victor's mail of 12 Nov states that as a service provider, Quillon must run segmentation penetration tests at least every six months and after any segmentation change [2]. The March 2026 Redline test only covers the first half of 2026, so a second H2 test is missing before fieldwork starts on Dec 8 [2]. Note that an agent reasoning on Nov 16 initially concluded the existing report was sufficient, but this was corrected the same day after Victor's mail was checked [1]. A second H2 test has since been booked with Redline for Nov 30 – Dec 2, with the report promised by Dec 4 [3][4].
